author: Russell Brand
description:
Sunday Service looks a little different this week. I’m here without Russell, but we’ve decided to keep going. I open with a reading from Philippians, then share an episode we recorded together during the trial that we’d been holding back. We talk about why some of the coverage sounds like a football match and what it’s like to pray when something has taken over your whole week.

I read some of your comments, share a little Brother Lawrence and close with a message Russell asked me to read. Thank you for being here with me.
title: The Good Work Continues | SS25
